consequence.statement: MirrorMaker 1 support has been removed; environments using MirrorMaker 1 must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer.
consequence.remediation: Migrate existing MirrorMaker 1 deployments to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading Strimzi to version 0.46.0 or later.

original.statement: Support for MirrorMaker 1 has been removed in Strimzi 0.46.0; users must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading.

decision.reason: [ev-87094cfdd770] says MirrorMaker 1 support has been removed and tells users to migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer. That is a required operator step before the upgrade, so migration-required (action) is the right kind. [ev-5d8b8b113b70] confirms the removal. The proposed statement and remediation say only what the evidence says.
